definition:
vrf definition PARTNER-VPN-CONTOSO
 rd 65000:100
 !
 address-family ipv4
 exit-address-family
!
interfaces:
interface GigabitEthernet0/1.100
 description +++ PARTNER-VPN-CONTOSO LAN +++
 encapsulation dot1Q 100
 vrf forwarding PARTNER-VPN-CONTOSO
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
!
interface Tunnel100
 description *** IPSec VTI to Contoso (demo) ***
 vrf forwarding PARTNER-VPN-CONTOSO
 ip unnumbered Loopback0
 ip nat outside
 ip tcp adjust-mss 1380
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel destination 198.51.100.2
 tunnel protection ipsec profile CONTOSO-IPSEC-PROFILE
!
nat_inside_dynamic: ip nat inside source list ACL-CONTOSO-NAT pool CONTOSO-NAT-POOL vrf PARTNER-VPN-CONTOSO overload
bgp:
router bgp 65000
 address-family ipv4 vrf PARTNER-VPN-CONTOSO
  network 192.0.2.0 mask 255.255.255.0
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 remote-as 64550
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 description +++ Contoso partner BGP peer (demo) +++
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 timers 5 15
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 activate
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 send-community both
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 soft-reconfiguration inbound
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 route-map RM-CONTOSO-IN in
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 route-map RM-CONTOSO-OUT out
 exit-address-family
 !

RM-CONTOSO-IN:
route-map RM-CONTOSO-IN permit 10
 description +++ Accept routes from Contoso (demo) +++
!
RM-CONTOSO-OUT:
route-map RM-CONTOSO-OUT permit 10
 description +++ Advertise Primary-site routes to Contoso (demo) +++
 match ip address prefix-list PL-CONTOSO-OUT
 set community 65000:6300
!

ACL-CONTOSO-NAT:
ip access-list extended ACL-CONTOSO-NAT
 10 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 any
!

keyring:
crypto ikev2 keyring CONTOSO-KEYRING
 peer CONTOSO-PEER
  address 198.51.100.2
  pre-shared-key DEMO-PSK-CONTOSO-0001-CHANGE-ME
 !
!
profile:
crypto ikev2 profile CONTOSO-VTI-PROFILE
 match identity remote address 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.255
 authentication remote pre-share
 authentication local pre-share
 keyring local CONTOSO-KEYRING
!

crypto ipsec profile CONTOSO-IPSEC-PROFILE
 set transform-set CONTOSO-TS
 set ikev2-profile CONTOSO-VTI-PROFILE
!
transform_set:
crypto ipsec transform-set CONTOSO-TS esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
